name: TopologyCanvas
description:
A pannable, zoomable network map that lays nodes out as a family tree with clustered blocks,
with arrow-key navigation between nodes, selection, a right-click node menu, a minimap and
an optional list view in the same box. It shows a skeleton while `nodes` is undefined.

Keyboard: the arrow keys move between nodes like a family tree, Enter selects, Space
toggles the selection, Escape clears it, + and − zoom, 0 fits the map, and Shift+F10 opens
the focused node's menu.
signature: <T>({ label, nodes, clusters, renderNode, describeNode, selectedId, onSelect, onOpen, nodeMenu, frameKey, view, onViewChange, list, minimap, emptyText, insets, className, }: TopologyCanvasProps<T>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: clusters
props.description: How cluster keys are named and ordered.

props.name: describeNode
props.description: The node's accessible name: "Switch ORB-SW-CORE, Online, wired 1 Gbps to FA-GW01". Default: its label.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: One line for an empty map (R2.5).

props.name: frameKey
props.description: Re-fit when this changes (another network). Live changes to the same map keep the camera.

props.name: insets
props.description:
Page chrome floating over a full-bleed canvas, in CSS pixels (useBleed): fitting, the
controls, the minimap and the way to a focused node stay clear of it, and an untouched
camera re-fits when it changes. `null` means "being measured": the canvas holds its
loading shape and its first frame back until it is known, so nothing jumps (R9).

props.name: label
props.description: Names the map: "Network map, Office LAN".

props.name: list
props.description: The list view's content: a DataTable of the same nodes, with TopologyViewToggle in its toolbar.

props.name: minimap
props.description: Show the minimap where there is room (the user can turn it off). Default true.

props.name: nodes
props.description: undefined while loading: the skeleton shows in the same box.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Double-click (and the caller's Open action): the node's page.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the node id the person selects (click, Enter or Space), or `null` to clear: Space on the selected node, Escape, or a click on empty canvas. Pair with `selectedId` to show the selection.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Called with the view the person switches to from the view toggle in the map's controls; the toggle shows only when this is set. Pair with `view`.

props.name: renderNode
props.description: The node's tile (an identity's icon tier). Keep it stable (useCallback).

props.name: selectedId
props.description: Stable identifier of the selected item.
